facts.title: zucchini and almond pasta salad
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds zucchini (2 to 3, depending on size), halved lenthwise and very thinly sliced
1 1/2 ounces parmesan or pecorino romano cheese, thinly sliced on a mandoline or with a peeler
1/2 cup slivered almonds, well-toasted and cooled (300 degree oven for 7 to 10 minutes, tossing occasionally, usually works)
1/2 pound pasta of your choice, cooked, drained and cooled
facts.author: Deb Perelman
